I couldn't get the answer from gbrain. It refused to look up the private note I saved for her because this bot's gbrain connection isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read. I took the answer from her own DM history with me instead, which she can see herself.

Private notes saved for members can't be looked up until someone fixes this on the gbrain server. Its suggested fix is to tie the connection to one member:

    gbrain auth rescope --token <bot token> --member '<MEMBER>'

Because this is a shared bot, the better option is to list the members it may act for (`--may-act-for <members>`) and name the person on each request. Either change has to be made by whoever runs the gbrain server.
